summary: Verified TeamNest.ai MOBILE PARITY for the AI Employee Builder + the new multi-turn sandbox memory on the shared FastAPI backend. Backend: 13/13 pytest passing in /app/backend/tests/test_iteration96_mobile_parity.py — demo-login → JWT Bearer flow, dashboard/templates/employees list, style-connectors + permission-options + marketplace-categories, permissions PUT+GET ('Draft only'), deploy/undeploy with handle 'test_mobile_parity_bot', marketplace publish → browse (GET /api/ai-builder/marketplace) → detail → mine → unpublish. Multi-turn sandbox memory VERIFIED end-to-end: turn 1 posted 'My name is Zephyrion Blakewood', turn 2 with same session_id posted 'What is my name?' and Claude Fable-5 replied 'Zephyrion Blakewood' — confirmed the session_id is preserved on the 2nd response, GET /test-runs?session_id= filter returns both turns, and omitting session_id starts a new session (different id). Mobile UI (Expo web preview at 390x844): tapped mb-back-then-verify by page.goto /builder → dashboard mb-create-btn found → opened Create modal → filled mb-name-input=TEST_MB_UI_Emp → mb-create-submit → navigated to /builder/{id} editor. All 7 mb-sec-{profile,training,examples,style,sandbox,permissions,deploy} segmented buttons render. On the Sandbox section, mb-sandbox-input + mb-sandbox-send worked; sent 'My name is Zephyrion Blakewood…', then 'What is my name?' — the AI bubble replied 'Your name is Zephyrion Blakewood.' with model tag claude-fable-5 and thumbs-up/down (mb-run-good-/mb-run-bad-) rate row. Marketplace route loaded (Marketplace / Discover & install AI employees.), 3 mkt tabs (Browse/My listings/Installed), search box + 'All' chip visible, 'No listings yet.' empty state. Web parity: /ai-builder page renders 'AI Employee' UI; /ai-builder/marketplace renders 3 mkt-tab-* tabs, mkt-search, 12+ category chips. Web Sandbox tab: ep-tab-sandbox + ep-sandbox-input + ep-sandbox-send + ep-sandbox-new ('New conversation') button all present. EmployeeProfile.jsx confirmed sends session_id on 2nd turn (lines 499-516). TEST_ cleanup: all TEST_ employees (TEST_Mobile_Parity, TEST_MB_UI_Emp, TEST_Web_Parity) deleted; verified via GET /employees.

issues: CARRY-OVER from iterations 93/94/95: 'Credit specials' upsell modal + 'Have you met AI CMO?' cross-sell card still re-render over the employee-profile page and can intercept clicks on Sandbox/Permissions/Deploy tabs. Not blocking this iteration but still worth persisting a session-scoped dismiss.

Initial dashboard load appears to omit the stats row (mb-stat-Total/Deployed/In market) and the START-FROM-A-TEMPLATE cards on cold navigation from an external page.goto (they appeared later after Create flow). Templates fetch is triggered inside useFocusEffect + load() — from a hard page.goto the fetches fired but the rendered stats card was blank in the screenshot. May be a first-paint / promise-race issue. Not reproducible from tab-based nav.

react_native_issues.issue: React Native web deprecation warning 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents' fires on the builder screens. Likely from a third-party lib (react-native-safe-area-context / Modal). Reference: console warning during /builder mount.

action_items: OPTIONAL: on /app/mobile/app/builder/index.tsx, prefetch stats+templates once at cold-mount (or add a small loading skeleton) so a direct-link entry doesn't show a blank stats row on first paint.
CARRY-OVER: persist a session-scoped dismiss for the Credit-specials modal + AI CMO cross-sell on the web /ai-builder/:id page (flagged since iteration 93).
OPTIONAL: silence the React Native web 'pointerEvents' deprecation — audit for pointerEvents='none' props (likely inside CreateModal overlay) and move them to style.pointerEvents.
critical_code_review_comments: routes/ai_employee_builder.py sandbox_reply (lines 599-616): now supports multi-turn history via session_id + prior test-runs — nice. Consider bounding the history slice: today it loads up to 50 prior runs and feeds ALL of them to build_system_prompt which will silently blow the LLM context on a long session. Cap at last N (say 20) turns.

mobile app/builder/[id].tsx SandboxSection loads runs but only shows the LATEST session on mount by filtering client-side (line 249). If the user hits 'New' it wipes runs to [] but does NOT tell the backend — a subsequent send will still generate a NEW session_id (good). However, when the user returns to the tab later, the code re-loads and jumps back to the LATEST session. Consider persisting the client's active session_id (e.g. via searchParams) so the 'New' state is stable across navigations.

mobile app/builder/[id].tsx PermissionsSection saveLevel (line 304) fires PUT on every radio tap with no debounce; a rapid double-tap on two levels back-to-back may fire two PUTs racing. Debounce or disable radios while a save is in-flight.

mobile src/api.ts stores the JWT in a module-scope `let _token` — on a hard reload the token is lost. If the app is expected to survive a browser refresh in the Expo web preview, persist to AsyncStorage/SecureStore + hydrate on boot. Otherwise document that the demo-login must be re-run after refresh.
backend services/ai_employee_runtime.py generate_reply: history is passed in but the function should also cap the total token size — a long-running sandbox session with 20+ turns will grow linearly.
test_credentials: Mobile: tap [data-testid="demo-login-btn"] on login screen (returns JWT). Web: POST /api/auth/demo-login (tn_session cookie) or amit@demo.team / Demo@2026.
